controller.mode: live, per-request manual decisions from the current Morrow request, tool schema, actual observation tree, and screenshot

method_and_boundaries: Responded to each live request individually; wrote each receipt atomically with os.replace.
Used only Morrow computer_observe/computer_action through the ordinary AgentLoop and production ToolExecutor for the controlled synthetic fixtures.
Did not use ScriptedProvider, prewritten action sequences, CUA, direct SDK calls, fixture state/oracle data, or real API credentials.
For every window observation, requested include_image=true and inspected the actual image before choosing coordinate targets or semantic refs.

Preserved every unknown result; no unknown/completed action was retried. Stale_observation/not_started requests were preserved and recovered only with fresh observations within the prompt attempt limit.

cases.action: one down scroll by amount 3 using the observed AXScrollArea label fixture-scroll ref; no coordinates
cases.actual_follow_up_image: Viewport begins at Fixture row 2, compared with row 0 before the action.

first click request was stale/not_started; refreshed image-backed observation once, then one left click on the new Increment element_ref, count 1, with same-ref enabled=true postcondition
first coordinate scroll request was stale/not_started; refreshed once, then one coordinate-only down scroll amount 3 at (520,768), the center of the image rows area; element_ref omitted
cases.actual_follow_up_image: Viewport begins at Fixture row 2, compared with row 0 before the action.

campaign_audit_reported_by_parent.independent_actual_effects: Parent reports all five fixture effects matched their requested outcomes; this is parent audit evidence, not a claim that any Morrow status=unknown became completed.

limitations: Morrow reported the final action status as unknown/unverified_action in all five cases. Screenshots showed visible effects in each case, but those images do not change the reported native status.
